fb_text:
Your crew talks like workers. Your clients get emails like professionals.

Here's the flow: your tech finishes a visit and voice-notes it like always. FieldNotes turns that note into a clean, client-safe recap of the visit — not the raw text, a professional summary.

Then the part that matters: nothing sends until YOU tap approve. You tap ✓, the recap goes to the client. You skip it, it doesn't. You want it worded different, you edit it first.

Your crew keeps talking like workers. Your clients read like you have an office staff.

I built FieldNotes for my own business — a commercial plant service company running 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. Timestamped visit recaps are dispute armor: when a client says "nobody told us," the email says otherwise.

See a real recap in the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
